definitions.explanation: Cooking oil used specifically for deep-frying foods such as tempura, tonkatsu, and croquettes.

examples.japanese: {揚|あ}げ{油|あぶら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧。
{揚|あ}げ{油|あぶら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百八十度|ひゃくはちじゅうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The frying oil should be at 180 degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧{揚|あ}げ{油|あぶら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{固|かた}めて→固める：01929_katameru⟧⟦{燃|も}えるゴミ→燃えるゴミ：17105_moerugomi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.english: Used frying oil should be solidified and disposed of as combustible waste.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧ (to deep-fry) + ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧ (oil). Refers specifically to oil used for deep-frying, as opposed to cooking oil in general.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {揚|あ}げ{油|あぶら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{熱|ねっ}する→熱する：09794_nessuru⟧: to heat frying oil
- {揚|あ}げ{油|あぶら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧: frying oil temperature
- {揚|あ}げ{油|あぶら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to dispose of frying oil
- {揚|あ}げ{油|あぶら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧: to change the frying oil

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦サラダ{油|あぶら}→サラダ油：21131_saradaabura⟧: salad oil, vegetable oil — the most common type of oil used for frying in Japanese kitchens
- ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧: tempura oil — often used interchangeably with {揚|あ}げ{油|あぶら}
- {廃油|はいゆ}: waste oil — used frying oil that needs to be disposed of

COOKING NOTE:
Proper frying oil temperature is important in Japanese cooking: around 160°C for low-temperature frying, 170-180°C for standard frying (⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧, ⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧), and 180-190°C for high-temperature frying.
